title: MLLM-Bench: Evaluating Multimodal LLMs with Per-sample Criteria

bias_targets.methodology: Shuffling the order of the paired answers in the evaluation prompt to check if the judge model (GPT-4V) exhibits a preference for an answer based purely on its position (e.g., consistently preferring Answer 1 or Answer 2).
Analyzing the correlation between the evaluator model's decisions and the token length difference between the two evaluated answers to determine if the judge has a preference for longer outputs.
